bottleneck.description: Full-stack superconducting quantum-computing company with an in-house superconducting-chip fab (Fab-1); pre-commercial, with no part of the stack yet dependent on it.

dependency.key_customers: US Air Force Research Laboratory, DARPA, Amazon Braket (distribution)

editorial.notes: Quantum computing is pre-commercial research, and nothing in robotics, semiconductors, space or materials depends on Rigetti today; usage is experimental and revenue is immaterial. The field is crowded and contestable, with IBM, Google, IonQ, Quantinuum and others, and effectively no switching lock-in for users. Its in-house Fab-1, described as the first dedicated quantum foundry, is a genuine vertical-integration differentiator worth noting, but it is a capability Rigetti uses for itself rather than an input others must buy, so it creates no control point. Rated LOW with high confidence, the textbook pre-commercial case.
